notes.title: Patch notes: v1.0.1
notes.content: [p]An update has been pushed to fix some UI issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Added[/p][list][*][p]Language selector not available at the start of the game or options. Now you can choose language in the User Agreement popup. This selector is also available in the options screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]Changed[/p][list][*][p]The order of the tabs in Options screen has been adjusted to put settings first.[/p][/*][*][p]The language selector in the main nav has improved visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixed[/p][list][*][p]Certain screen resolutions not displaying all available UI elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Full game release not showing correct version number.[/p][/*][*][p]Intro story moving too fast between segments. Unable to read it fully before it changes.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Language selector not available at the start of the game or options. Now you can choose language in the User Agreement popup. This selector is also available in the options screen.

tags.bug: Certain screen resolutions not displaying all available UI elements.
Full game release not showing correct version number.
Intro story moving too fast between segments. Unable to read it fully before it changes.
